course.title: Unit 3 Could you please clean your room?【例句】

sentences.content: Peter, could you please take out the rubbish?
sentences.english: Peter , could you please take out the rubbish ?
sentences.chinese: Peter，你能把垃圾拿出去吗？

sentences.content: Sure, Mom.
sentences.english: Sure , Mom
sentences.chinese: 好的，妈妈。

sentences.content: Could you please sweep the floor?
sentences.english: Could you please sweep the floor ?
sentences.chinese: 你能帮忙扫一下地吗？

sentences.content: Yes, sure.
sentences.english: Yes , sure
sentences.chinese: 好的，没问题。

sentences.content: Can you do the dishes?
sentences.english: Can you do the dishes ?
sentences.chinese: 你能洗碗吗？

sentences.content: Well, could you please do them?
sentences.english: Well , could you please do them ?
sentences.chinese: 那么，你能处理一下吗？

sentences.content: I’m going to clean the living room.
sentences.english: I'm going to clean the living room
sentences.chinese: 我要打扫客厅。

sentences.content: No problem.
sentences.english: No problem
sentences.chinese: 没问题。

sentences.content: Tony, could you please help out with a few things?
sentences.english: Tony , could you please help out with a few things ?
sentences.chinese: Tony，你能帮忙处理几件事吗？

sentences.content: Could I at least finish watching this show?
sentences.english: Could I at least finish watching this show ?
sentences.chinese: 我至少能看完这个节目吧？

sentences.content: No. I think two hours of TV is enough for you!
sentences.english: No . I think two hours of TV is enough for you !
sentences.chinese: 不，我觉得你看两小时电视就够了！

sentences.content: Fine. What do you want me to do?
sentences.english: Fine . What do you want me to do ?
sentences.chinese: 好吧。你想让我做什么？

sentences.content: Could you take out the rubbish, fold the clothes and do the dishes?
sentences.english: Could you take out the rubbish , fold the clothes and do the dishes ?
sentences.chinese: 你能把垃圾拿出去，把衣服叠好，再把碗洗了吗？

sentences.content: So much?
sentences.english: So much ?
sentences.chinese: 这么多？

sentences.content: Yes, because Mom will be back from shopping any minute now.
sentences.english: Yes , because Mom will be back from shopping any minute now
sentences.chinese: 是的，因为妈妈随时都会购物回来。

sentences.content: And she won’t be happy if she sees this mess.
sentences.english: And she won't be happy if she sees this mess
sentences.chinese: 如果她看到这一团糟，肯定不会高兴的。

wordDetails.definition: see（第三人称单数）: 看见

sentences.content: But the house is already pretty clean and tidy!
sentences.english: But the house is already pretty clean and tidy !
sentences.chinese: 但这房子已经相当干净整洁了！

sentences.content: Yes, well, it’s clean, but it’s not “mother clean”!
sentences.english: Yes , well , it's clean , but it's not " mother clean "!
sentences.chinese: 没错，是挺干净的，但还没到“妈妈级清洁”的程度！

sentences.content: Last month, our dog welcomed me when I came home from school.
sentences.english: Last month , our dog welcomed me when I came home from school
sentences.chinese: 上个月，当我从学校回到家时，我们的狗狗迎接了我。

sentences.content: He wanted a walk, but I was too tired.
sentences.english: He wanted a walk , but I was too tired
sentences.chinese: 他想去散步，但我太累了。

sentences.content: I threw down my bag and went to the living room.
sentences.english: I threw down my bag and went to the living room
sentences.chinese: 我扔下包，走向客厅。

sentences.content: The minute I sat down in front of the TV, my mom came over.
sentences.english: The minute I sat down in front of the TV , my mom came over
sentences.chinese: 我刚在电视机前坐下，妈妈就走了过来。

sentences.content: “Could you please take the dog for a walk?” she asked.
sentences.english: " Could you please take the dog for a walk ?" she asked
sentences.chinese: “你能带狗狗去散个步吗？”她问道。

sentences.content: “Could I watch one show first?” I asked.
sentences.english: " Could I watch one show first ?" I asked
sentences.chinese: “我能先看一集节目吗？”我问道。

sentences.content: “No!” she replied angrily.
sentences.english: " No !" she replied angrily
sentences.chinese: “不！”她愤怒地回答道。

sentences.content: “You watch TV all the time and never help out around the house!
sentences.english: " You watch TV all the time and never help out around the house !
sentences.chinese: 你整天就知道看电视，从来不做家务！

sentences.content: I can’t work all day and do housework all evening.”
sentences.english: I can't work all day and do housework all evening ."
sentences.chinese: 我不能白天工作一整天，晚上还要做家务。

sentences.content: “Well, I work all day at school, too! I’m just as tired as you are!” I shouted back.
sentences.english: " Well , I work all day at school , too ! I'm just as tired as you are !" I shouted back
sentences.chinese: “哼，我在学校也整天工作！我和你一样累！”我大声回怼道。

sentences.content: My mom did not say anything and walked away.
sentences.english: My mom did not say anything and walked away
sentences.chinese: 我妈妈什么也没说就走开了。

wordDetails.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问或否定

sentences.content: For one week, she did not do any housework and neither did I.
sentences.english: For one week , she did not do any housework and neither did I
sentences.chinese: 整整一周，她没做任何家务，我也一样。

sentences.content: Finally, I could not find a clean dish or a clean shirt.
sentences.english: Finally , I could not find a clean dish or a clean shirt
sentences.chinese: 最终，我连一个干净的盘子或一件干净的衬衫都找不到。

sentences.content: The next day, my mom came home from work to find the house clean and tidy.
sentences.english: The next day , my mom came home from work to find the house clean and tidy
sentences.chinese: 第二天，妈妈下班回家时发现房子干净整洁。

sentences.content: “What happened?” she asked in surprise.
sentences.english: " What happened ?" she asked in surprise
sentences.chinese: “发生什么事了？”她惊讶地问道。

sentences.content: “I’m so sorry, Mom.
sentences.english: " I'm so sorry , Mom
sentences.chinese: 对不起，妈妈。

sentences.content: I finally understand that we need to share the housework to have a clean and comfortable home,” I replied.
sentences.english: I finally understand that we need to share the housework to have a clean and comfortable home ," I replied
sentences.chinese: 我终于明白，我们需要分担家务才能拥有一个干净舒适的家。

sentences.content: Could I go out for dinner with my friends?
sentences.english: Could I go out for dinner with my friends ?
sentences.chinese: 我可以和朋友出去吃晚饭吗？

sentences.content: Sure, that should be OK.
sentences.english: Sure , that should be OK
sentences.chinese: 当然，这应该没问题。

sentences.content: Could we get something to drink after the movie?
sentences.english: Could we get something to drink after the movie ?
sentences.chinese: 看完电影后我们能喝点东西吗？

sentences.content: No, you can’t. You have a basketball game tomorrow.
sentences.english: No , you can't . You have a basketball game tomorrow
sentences.chinese: 不行，你不能去。明天你还有一场篮球比赛。

sentences.content: Could you please take the dog for a walk?
sentences.english: Could you please take the dog for a walk ?
sentences.chinese: 你能带狗狗去散步吗？

sentences.content: OK, but I want to watch one show first.
sentences.english: OK , but I want to watch one show first
sentences.chinese: 好的，不过我想先看一集节目。

sentences.content: Could you please take out the rubbish?
sentences.english: Could you please take out the rubbish ?
sentences.chinese: 你能把垃圾拿出去吗？

sentences.content: Yes, sure.
sentences.english: Yes , sure
sentences.chinese: 好的，当然。
